details.description: Kimi K2.6 is an open-source multimodal agentic model from Moonshot AI, built as a 1-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 32 billion activated parameters and a 256K-token context window. It accepts text, image and video input and offers both a thinking (extended reasoning) mode and a non-thinking (instant) mode, aimed at long-horizon coding, design tasks, autonomous agent execution, and coordinating multiple sub-agents.
advantages: Scores 80.2% on SWE-bench Verified and 89.6% on LiveCodeBench (v6), per Moonshot AI's model card.
Scores 96.4% on AIME 2026 and 90.5% on GPQA-Diamond in thinking mode, per Moonshot AI's model card.
Can coordinate agent swarms of up to 300 sub-agents executing tasks together, per Moonshot AI's model card.
Supports image and video understanding via an integrated MoonViT vision encoder, per Moonshot AI's model card.
use_cases: Long-horizon coding across multiple languages including Rust, Go and Python
Autonomous agent execution with web browsing, code interpretation and search tool integration
Multi-agent coordination for complex, long-running tasks
Visual understanding tasks such as chart and document analysis

sources.title: Kimi Open Platform - Chat Model Pricing

notes: BrowseComp, DeepSearchQA and HLE-Full agentic scores and the V* vision score from the Hugging Face card are not accuracy-style leaderboard scores in the same sense as the others (some are F1 or tool-augmented composite scores), so they were left out of evaluations to stay conservative; they are documented on the same model card if wanted. Catalog facts list max_input_tokens and max_output_tokens both at 262144; Moonshot AI's own pages describe the context window as 256K tokens (262,144), which is consistent.
